changeSet.sql: WITH payload_source AS ( SELECT application.request_id, withdraw.assignee, (ra.payload -> 'officialNotice') as official_notice, (application.payload -> 'withholdingOfAllowances') as woa_data, (application.payload -> 'sectionsCompleted') as sections, (withdraw.payload -> 'closeJustification') as justification, (withdraw.payload -> 'withholdingWithdrawalAttachments') as attachments, (withdraw.payload -> 'sectionsCompleted') as withdrawal_sections FROM request_task_history application JOIN request_task_history withdraw ON application.request_id = withdraw.request_id JOIN request_action ra ON application.request_id = ra.request_id WHERE application.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_APPLICATION_SUBMIT' AND withdraw.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_WITHDRAWAL_APPLICATION_SUBMIT' AND ra.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED' ) UPDATE request r SET payload = jsonb_build_object( 'payloadType', 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_REQUEST_PAYLOAD', 'regulatorAssignee', ps.assignee, 'closeJustification', ps.justification, 'decisionNotification', jsonb_build_object('signatory', ps.assignee), 'withholdingOfAllowances', jsonb_build_object( 'year', (ps.woa_data -> 'year'), 'reasonType', (ps.woa_data -> 'reasonType')), 'withholdingOfAllowancesOfficialNotice', ps.official_notice, 'withholdingOfAllowancesSectionsCompleted', ps.sections, 'withholdingOfAllowancesWithdrawalAttachments', ps.attachments, 'withholdingOfAllowancesWithdrawalSectionsCompleted', ps.withdrawal_sections) FROM payload_source ps WHERE r.id = ps.request_id and r.payload is NULL and r.type='WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES' and r.status='COMPLETED';

rollback.sql: WITH affected_ids AS ( SELECT application.request_id FROM request_task_history application JOIN request_task_history withdraw ON application.request_id = withdraw.request_id JOIN request_action ra ON application.request_id = ra.request_id WHERE application.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_APPLICATION_SUBMIT' AND withdraw.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_WITHDRAWAL_APPLICATION_SUBMIT' AND ra.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED' ) UPDATE request r SET payload = NULL FROM affected_ids ai WHERE r.id = ai.request_id AND r.type = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES' AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.payload ->> 'payloadType' = 'WITHHOLDING_OF_ALLOWANCES_REQUEST_PAYLOAD';
